text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0825 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on expected continued commercial and local selling as the Prairies see ideal growing conditions. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +0.38 Thursday from -3.74 Wednesday. July futures were considered over bought at the close when crushers covered shorts and was expected to fall C$1 to C$2 a tonne at the open. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3740 to the U.S. dollar, fell to 82.58 yen, rose to 1.2752 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on expected hedges with the trade watching whether UGG will deliver against its July long or sell the futures.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on spill over pressure.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
